Team —

We're two business days from the board packet cutoff. Finance needs a tight reconciliation of ARR and bookings for the materials; several items flagged in the workbook (attached) still need owner confirmation. High-level asks: 

1) Stage hygiene: update stage for any deals that moved since 8/1. We need closed/committed deals to be in the "Commit" bucket and demo/PO awaiting deals in "Advance". If you change stage, add a one-line rationale in the comment column of the attached CSV.

2) Commit verification: for all $100k+ deals we list as "commit" please confirm: contract signed, PO received, or legal redline resolved. If not, move to "best-effort commit" and note blocker.

3) Evidence for board: Laura, please add top-10 bookings evidence (contracts or signed SOW stubs) to the Drive folder and flag anything still pending.

4) Narrative bullets: Marissa, can you draft 3 bullets explaining any ARR variance >5% vs plan?

I attached the ARR_bookings_summary_Q3.xlsx and exported the pipeline as pipeline_stage_export_20260810.csv. Small reminder: do not create new rows in that CSV — update the Stage column and the Comments column only so Detective (the reconciliation script) stays deterministic.

I'll pull a consolidated list after EOD and circulate a final checklist for the finance team. If you expect any pushes to the board packet timeline, call out now.

Thanks —
Ben
